findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：公司、供應商與客戶自外國供應商進口部分原料、零組件與產品；貿易政策變動可能帶來關稅與貿易障礙。
findings.excerpt: We, our suppliers and our customers import certain raw materials, components and other products from foreign suppliers.

findings.claim: 10-K（FY2024）風險因素：若無法將關稅成本轉嫁客戶，經營結果可能受重大不利影響。
findings.excerpt: If we are unable to pass the costs of such tariffs on to our customer base or otherwise mitigate such costs, or if demand for our services decreases due to the higher cost, our results of operations could be materially adversely affected.

findings.claim: 公司依賴第三方分包商與設備／材料供應商；供應商未如期履約會損及執行與獲利（一般性依賴，未點名單一供應商或地區）。
findings.excerpt: We hire third-party subcontractors to perform work and depend on third-party suppliers to provide equipment and materials necessary to complete our projects.

findings.claim: 風險摘要稱商用 HVAC 設備、配電開關設備、大型發電機交期最長，常超過六個月（第三方彙整 SEC 揭露，非 10-K 原頁讀取）。
findings.excerpt: Orders for manufactured commercial HVAC equipment, electrical switch gear, and large application power generators have experienced the longest lead-times, and it is not uncommon for lead-times to be greater than six months.

findings.claim: 2026年5月法說會：管理層稱設備端供應鏈與關稅風險已透過合約緩解（二手法說摘要）。搜尋結果未發現公司將中國／台灣列為供應鏈曝險。

geo_supply_chain.note: 未找到點名中國／台灣或單一供應商的揭露；as_of 為 10-K 約略申報日（accession 為 2026 年 2 月），未逐頁驗證；法說會日期為約略值。直購商品占專案成本 40–45% 與 10–15% 兩數字衝突，未採用。
